text: opencode 1.18.27 serve API: SSE at GET /event with permission.asked {id,sessionID,permission,patterns,metadata.command,always,tool}, question.asked, session.status {type: idle|busy|retry}, session.idle, session.error; pending lists at GET /permission and GET /question; reply via POST /permission/:id/reply {reply: once|always|reject}; POST /session/:id/prompt_async returns 204; v2 variants exist under /api/* and permission.v2.* events

author: agent
text: A real opencode serve can be driven deterministically by an OpenAI-compatible mock provider: config provider.mock.npm=@ai-sdk/openai-compatible with options.baseURL, model mock/m1, permission.bash=ask; a streamed tool_calls chunk for bash produces permission.asked within 2 seconds

meta.lesson: Match processes with the bracket trick: ps -eo pid,args | grep '[o]pencode serve'; never pkill -f a literal that is also in your own command

meta.lesson: Never kill by pattern from a compound command. Start background services with setsid nohup and write $! to a pidfile, or find the owner of the port with ss -lptn, and kill that PID
